meta.via: parish, city and news sources (local sources)

services.name: New Orleans Emergency Medical Services (NOEMS)
services.area: whole parish (City of New Orleans = Orleans Parish)
services.evidence: New Orleans EMS is a professional healthcare organization that provides emergency treatment and transport to residents and visitors of the City of New Orleans and Orleans Parish.

22071.page_note: Acadian adds ambulances for Mardi Gras (2023 city release) and provides mutual aid, but is not the 911 primary.

services.name: East Baton Rouge Parish EMS (City-Parish)
services.evidence: East Baton Rouge EMS is a municipal emergency medical service ... 13 strategically located stations across the parish ... fleet of 20 ambulances ... In addition to 911 emergency response ... 911 Response only. No long distance transports.

services.name: Acadian Ambulance
services.area: hospital transfers and non-emergency; assists 911 only when requested by EBR EMS
services.evidence: Acadian also assists with emergency calls, although only when requested by Baton Rouge EMS.

22033.page_note: East Baton Rouge Parish EMS is the 911 provider; Acadian is not. Baton Rouge General sought an ambulance permit in August 2025 (four ambulances); the outcome was not found.

services.name: Acadian Ambulance Service
services.area: whole parish (Broussard also has its own direct agreement)
services.evidence: Others [municipalities] are covered by a parish-wide contract between Acadian and Lafayette Consolidated Government. ... Acadian Ambulance's existing contract with Lafayette Consolidated Government requires the company to respond to calls outside of Lafayette within 12 minutes 80% of the time.

22055.page_note: Acadian's Lafayette contract is documented from 2020 (a 2012-13 report called it exclusive in the parish), and on October 21, 2026 it opened a new Broussard station for southeast Lafayette Parish. Current contract text was not found.

services.name: Acadian Ambulance
services.ownership: private (contractor to Ouachita Council of Governments)
services.area: Ouachita Parish, Monroe and West Monroe (whole parish)
services.evidence: The Ouachita Council of Governments has renewed a five-year contract with Acadian Ambulance to continue providing emergency medical services in Ouachita Parish and the cities of Monroe and West Monroe, following a competitive proposal process.

22073.page_note: A new Acadian contract takes effect by December 31, 2026, with no gap in service.

services.name: Pafford EMS
services.ownership: private (contractor to Rapides Parish Police Jury)
services.evidence: The Rapides Parish Police Jury has selected Pafford EMS as the sole provider for ambulance services across Rapides Parish.

22079.page_note: The Police Jury chose Pafford EMS over Acadian in April 2025. Not yet confirmed: the date Pafford starts service.

services.name: Acadian Ambulance Service
services.ownership: private (contractor to Sabine Parish Police Jury)
services.evidence: Acadian Ambulance Service announced on October 15, that they had been confirmed by the Sabine Parish Police Jury as the sole ambulance provider in the parish beginning January 1, 2026.

22085.page_note: Acadian was chosen after an RFP by the Sabine Parish EMS Advisory Board.

services.name: Acadian Ambulance
services.ownership: private (contractor to Grant Parish Police Jury)
services.evidence: On November 13, 2025, the Grant Parish Police Jury has renewed its contract with Acadian Ambulance to provide emergency and non-emergency medical services. The exclusive five-year contract ...

22043.page_note: Acadian's own website reports a Police Jury action naming it. Not yet confirmed from Police Jury minutes or local news.

services.name: Shreveport Fire Department emergency ambulance units
services.evidence: Emergency medical service is provided by the Shreveport Fire Department emergency ambulance units.

22017.page_note: Shreveport Fire Department ambulances serve the city, and Shreveport is the 911 answering point. Not yet confirmed: the rest of the parish (fire districts and Ambulance Service District No. 1); Acadian lists Caddo in its North region, also unconfirmed.

22051.page_note: Hospital-run EMS since about 1980: East Jefferson General (east bank) and West Jefferson Medical Center (west bank). Not yet confirmed from a 2024 or later source; undated reports mention LCMC/West Jefferson talks with Acadian for the west bank.

22103.page_note: A 2008 JEMS article said Acadian was the sole provider in Slidell and that the parish required a 10-minute Acadian response in unincorporated areas. Not yet confirmed from a current source.

22019.page_note: Not yet confirmed from a public source: who provides 911 ambulance service in the parish.

22063.page_note: Not yet confirmed from a public source: who provides 911 ambulance service in the parish.

22105.page_note: Not yet confirmed from a public source: who provides 911 ambulance service. State law lets the parish run its own ambulance service, but no evidence was found of what it does.
